simple.summary: צִרְעָה (tsirʻâh) means a wasp (as stinging) First listed occurrence: Deut 7 20.

definitions.full: H6880. tsirah צִרְעָה noun feminine collective hornets (? as wounding, prostrating ; Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew); — allies of Israel; — ׳הַצּ Exod 23:28 ; Josh 24:12 (both E), Deut 7:20 .
